title: The DBMS must disable accounts when the accounts have expired.
check_content:
Verify the DBMS is configured to disable accounts when the accounts have expired.

If the DBMS is not configured to disable accounts when the accounts have expired, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the DBMS to disable accounts when the accounts have expired.
VulnDiscussion: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality, which reduce the attack surface of the system.
